checks.name: Shift-click eight links, ⌘B bundles them into one strand between two clips
Drag a clip: it follows live, one write on release
Drag the spine: both clips move
Moving a card re-routes its lanes live
Hovering a lane lights that whole link
Click the strand selects the bundle; Unbundle releases the links
Alt-drag a cut across the links gathers them; double-click a clip lets go
